16.t: Working with data: angle of attack
q: Describe how lift changes from 0° to 12°.
Lift increases steadily with angle, from 2 N to 10.5 N.
State the angle that gives most lift.
Explain the sudden fall after 14°, and why it is dangerous for a pilot.
The air can no longer follow the top of the wing; it breaks away and becomes turbulent (a stall). Lift drops suddenly, so the plane falls.
